title: Hedgehog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#2a2040"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="35" y="72" width="9" height="16" rx="4" fill="#c07830"/>
  <rect x="56" y="72" width="9" height="16" rx="4" fill="#d08840"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8a5020"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#a06028"/>

  <!-- arms up in dance -->
  <rect x="20" y="48" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#c07830" transform="rotate(-30 24 57)"/>
  <rect x="72" y="44" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#d08840" transform="rotate(35 76 53)"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx="17" cy="46" r="5" fill="#e8b060"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="58" r="5" fill="#f0c070"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#d08840"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#f0c878"/>

  <!-- spines on back -->
  <g stroke="#7a4a18" stroke-width="2" fill="#a86828">
    <polygon points="30,50 26,36 36,44"/>
    <polygon points="36,44 34,28 44,40"/>
    <polygon points="44,40 48,24 54,38"/>
    <polygon points="54,38 60,24 64,40"/>
    <polygon points="64,40 72,30 70,44"/>
    <polygon points="70,44 80,38 74,52"/>
  </g>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="16" fill="#e8a858"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#f8d090"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#5a3010"/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="30" r="5" fill="#d08840"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="30" r="5" fill="#d08840"/>

  <!-- eyes (happy dancing) -->
  <path d="M42 38 Q45 34 48 38" stroke="#2a1a0a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 38 Q57 34 60 38" stroke="#2a1a0a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 45 Q50 50 56 45" stroke="#2a1a0a" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="44" r="3" fill="#f09090" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="44" r="3" fill="#f09090" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- musical note -->
  <g fill="#80d0ff">
    <ellipse cx="82" cy="30" rx="4" ry="3.5"/>
    <rect x="85" y="14" width="2.5" height="16" fill="#80d0ff"/>
    <path d="M87 14 Q92 12 90 18" stroke="#80d0ff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#a0e0ff">
    <ellipse cx="16" cy="24" rx="3" ry="2.5"/>
    <rect x="18" y="11" width="2" height="13" fill="#a0e0ff"/>
  </g>
</svg>
